G="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.git/claude-tooling/venv/bin/claude-review-gate"; if [ ! -d "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.git" ]; then M=$(git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null); case "$M" in /*) G="$M/claude-tooling/venv/bin/claude-review-gate";; esac; fi; if [ -x "$G" ]; then exec "$G"; fi; P=$(sed -E 's/"(cwd|transcript_path|description)": *"([^"\\]|\\.)*"//g'); case "$P" in *commit*|*gh*pr*create*|*gh*pr*new*|*gh*pr*merge*|*.claude/reviews*) printf '%s\n' 'claude-review-gate: the claude-tooling environment of this clone (<git common dir>/claude-tooling/venv) has no claude-review-gate, so this command is blocked: it mentions commit, .claude/reviews, or gh with pr create, pr new or pr merge, which need the gate.
